root_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialization of the files array, sorted by path, with object keys sorted and separators comma/colon without whitespace. This is a source-catalog digest, not a Bitcoin commitment or Merkle inclusion proof.

anchoring.status_note: See system-audit-report for submission status. A submitted calendar receipt is not a confirmed Bitcoin anchor.
